title: salvia pratensis var. caerulea
intro: Salvia pratensis var. caerulea, commonly known as blue meadow sage, is a perennial plant species within the Salvia genus. It has been used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of blue meadow sage include its ability to act as an anxiolytic, reducing anxiety, and a spasmolytic, relaxing muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and rosmarinic acid, contributing to its therapeutic effects.
